objective: Enable sprint plan upload via UI, Node ingestion to database, owner-triggered orchestration run, and agent stream to UI for monitoring.

tickets.title: UI — Allow uploading sprint plan JSON to a project
tickets.objective: Add UI for owner to upload a sprint-plan JSON file to a specific project, with client-side schema validation and preview before submit.
acceptance_criteria: web UI adds Upload Sprint Plan button/dialog accepting .json file, shows preview of id, objective, tickets count, exit_criteria before submit
Client validates file against sprint-plan.schema.json (id, roadmap_id, project_id, objective, tickets[], exit_criteria) and shows errors inline for invalid JSON or schema mismatch
On submit calls POST /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans with multipart/form-data or JSON body { sprint_plan: <object> } and displays success or server validation error
After successful upload, UI refreshes dashboard to show new sprint in roadmap list
Unit test: frontend validation rejects invalid sprint JSON; integration test: upload of governance-sprint-plan-stabilization.json succeeds via HTTP API
Tests PASS: node --test <relevant frontend/unit tests>, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas

tickets.title: Node — Read sprint plan file, split and persist to database
tickets.objective: Node receives uploaded sprint plan, validates via Ajv against sprint-plan/ticket/roadmap schemas, splits tickets and persists to SQLite stores for orchestration.
acceptance_criteria: HTTP API adds POST /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans accepting JSON sprint plan; validates with Ajv against sprint-plan.schema.json, ticket.schema.json and roadmap reference; returns 400 with errors on invalid, 201 with { sprint_id, ticket_ids } on success
Server splits tickets[] and persists via roadmapStore, sprintPlanProjection, ticketProvenanceTracker into SQLite .node-control database; duplicate sprint id rejected with 409
Storage survives restart: after npm run dev:forge:stop/start, GET /projects/:projectId/dashboard and GET /projects/:projectId/history still show uploaded sprint
File path traversal and oversized payload rejected; projectId in URL must match sprint_plan.project_id
Integration test: POST the 16-ticket stabilization plan JSON, then GET /dashboard and GET /history verify persistence and provenance
Tests PASS: node --test tests/integration/sprint-plan*.test.js and tests/unit/roadmap-store.test.js, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check

tickets.title: UI + Node — Owner click Run to start orchestration
tickets.objective: When owner clicks Run on a sprint in UI, Node starts code orchestration via runtimeService/agentRuntime with filesystem-aware context, watcher/indexer, and verification pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard adds Run button for current sprint; on click calls POST /projects/:projectId/sprint-plans/:sprintId/run or POST /tasks with { projectId, sprintId }; button shows running state and disables duplicate run

Node handler validates sprint exists and not already running, creates session via runtimeService.startTask with agentRuntime injected (T12), publisher events agent.started/plan.created persisted to EventStore (T02/T13)

Agent execution uses filesystem-aware contextService (T11), project-file-tool (T14) with projectRoot guard, secrets redaction (T01), context budget 40k/30k (T07), watcher/indexer (T13B) and verification (T13B) triggered after file write

Smoke test without mocks: POST sprint run for stabilization plan -> Agent writes file -> watcher emits watcher.file_created -> indexer updates indexDb -> verification runs -> history shows verification.result
Duplicate Run while running rejected with 409; idempotent run after completion succeeds

Tests PASS: node --test tests/integration/runtime*.test.js and tests/integration/agent-runtime.test.js, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check; node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs shows RuntimeService->AgentRuntime WIRED

tickets.title: Stream agent results to UI for owner monitoring
tickets.objective: Stream agent lifecycle and verification events to UI in real time via SSE for owner to monitor orchestration progress.
acceptance_criteria: conversationStream SSE at GET /projects/:projectId/conversations/:conversationId/stream emits live agent.* events (agent.started, agent.plan.created, agent.step.started/completed, agent.completed/failed) and verification.result with Last-Event-ID/?after replay (T13C)

UI subscribes via EventSource on Run, renders streaming updates without polling; history/dashboard reflect same events via GET /projects/:projectId/history and GET /projects/:projectId/dashboard (EventStore persistence T02)
Failure path streams: agent.failed and verification timeout (T09) visible via SSE without crashing Node; owner sees error message

E2E smoke without mocks: UI Run -> SSE client receives agent.started then agent.completed within timeout and verification.result appears, verified by curl history and node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs Agent stream->UI SSE WIRED

Tests PASS: node --test tests/unit/runtime-stream.test.js and tests/integration/memory-pipeline-e2e.test.js, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check; import probe all green

exit_criteria: Upload of a valid sprint-plan JSON via UI succeeds, persists to SQLite, survives Node restart, and appears in dashboard/history
Owner Run triggers agent orchestration that writes files, updates index, runs verification, and streams agent.* plus verification.result to UI via SSE

All 4 tickets pass acceptance with node --test relevant tests, npm run lint, npm run typecheck, npm run validate:schemas, git diff --check, and node scripts/test-e2e-flow.mjs shows WIRED for RuntimeService->AgentRuntime, ContextEngine->Agent, Watcher->Indexer, Indexer->Verification, Verification->UI, Agent stream->UI SSE
